description: Create a new local Maven repository in JFrog Artifactory with the following settings: Repository Key: 'team-releases', Repository Type: Local, Package Type: Maven, Description: 'Team release artifacts repository'. Log in to Artifactory at http://localhost:8082 using username 'admin' and password 'password'. Navigate to Administration > Repositories > Add Repositories > Local Repository, select Maven as the package type, enter the repository key 'team-releases', add the description 'Team release artifacts repository', and save. NOTE: If you see a 'Welcome to JFrog Artifactory' or password change prompt on first login, you may skip or dismiss it. The repository must appear in the repositories list when done.
